requestBody.query: How to install and use the smart door lock in Bell Smart Home?

200.answer: To install the door lock, follow the smart door lock installation instructions. With the Bell Smart Home app, you can manage user access settings, view/add/edit users, create custom user PINs, and select a timeframe for access.

snippets.text: How to install and use the smart door lock  - collapsed img_smart_doorlock To install your door lock, follow the smart door lock installation instructions. (PDF 17.52 MB). Once completed, make sure you add the device to your Bell Smart Home system. Add/delete/change door lock codes With the Bell Smart Home app, you can manage user access settings for your system and locks. With the Bell Smart Home app, you can: View, add and edit which users have access to locks and the security panel Create a custom user PIN while on the go Select a timeframe for access – at all times, for some of the time or for a limited time Add a user code using the Bell Smart Home app Log in to the app. Touch the menu image003_menubold . Touch Users. Touch the + sign. Enter the user's first and last name and then touch Create. In Access Code, enter the user's desired code.
